title: Infection-Control Placements: Therapeutic Closing Charge Tier
content:
**Isolation placement pricing — Bed-Hold and Leave Reservations, therapeutic closing charge.** For the therapeutic closing daily charge: The room held counts as an isolation placement when the resident's Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency agreement carries an isolation placement and the agreement's tier is the tier of the room held, the agreement's last room change, the center's infection-control move, being dated no later than the departure date; such a room is priced at its isolation billing tier, as the private-pay agreement prices that room's room and board: a private secure memory care room at the semi-private secure memory care tier and any other private room at the semi-private long-term care tier; any other room held is priced at its own tier.

The agreement read is the resident's current Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency agreement: the agreement that is active, else the one in its notice period, else the one converted to another payer source.

| Records | Tier whose schedule rate prices the therapeutic closing daily charge |
|---|---|
| Isolation placement on the agreement, agreement's tier is the tier of the room held, last room change dated no later than the departure date, room held is a Private Secure Memory Care Room | Semi-Private Secure Memory Care Room |
| Same, room held is a Private Long-Term Care Room, a Private Bariatric Care Room or a Private Suite with Sitting Area | Semi-Private Long-Term Care Room |
| No isolation placement on the agreement, a last room change dated after the departure date or not on the agreement, or the room held is not the agreement's room | the tier of the room held |

**Date boundary.** A last room change dated on the departure date itself is no later than the departure date and counts; one dated the day after the departure date does not, and the room is priced at its own tier.

**Hypothetical.** A resident whose agreement records an isolation placement in a Private Bariatric Care Room, moved there well before the leave, and whose reservation holds that same tier, has the held bed priced at the Semi-Private Long-Term Care Room rate. Had the reservation held a Private Long-Term Care Room instead, the agreement's tier would not be the tier of the room held, and the room would be priced at its own tier.
